verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online imports bank and card transactions and claims to automatically sort expenses, which covers automatic categorization of imported transactions. A community post also confirms that rule-based categorization exists in QBO. No evidence shows the suggestions learn from user corrections; user-built rules are a different mechanism from learned behavior. Missing for 10: documented learning from corrections, detail on how suggestions are presented and reviewed, and hands-on corroboration of suggestion accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get automatic categorization suggestions for imported transactions that learn from my corrections

citations.quote: Automatically sort expenses to stay ready for tax time
